name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for IT Hardware Scheme 2.O
benefit:
> The scheme provides a financial incentive for the net incremental sales of goods manufactured in India and covered under the target segment.

1. Target Segment Products: The tangible benefits apply to the manufacturing of Laptops, Tablets, All-in-One Personal Computers (PCs), Servers, and Ultra Small Form Factor (USSF) devices.
1. **Incentive Rates (Year 1 → Year 6):**

    - Assembly of Laptops
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a company registered in India. 1. The applicant should propose to manufacture goods covered under the Target Segment. 1. The applicant must meet the threshold criteria of Incremental Investment. 1. The applicant must meet the threshold criteria of Net Incremental Sales of manufactured target segment goods over the base year. 1. The applicant should meet the qualification criteria based on Consolidated Global Manufacturing Revenue for Financial Year 2021-22. 1. The applicant under the Global Company category must have a Consolidated Global Manufacturing Revenue greater than ₹50,00,00,00,000/- (5,000 crore) for the target segment or greater than ₹100,00,00,00,000/- (10,000 crore) for electronics hardware. 1. The applicant under the Domestic Company category must have a Consolidated Global Manufacturing Revenue greater than ₹1,00,00,000/- (10 crore) for the target segment or greater than ₹2,00,00,000/- (20 crore) for electronics hardware. 1. The applicant must localise at least Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA) and assembly of finished goods from the first year.
